corrected_text: Agello (a69121286e) guards the KV cache on each chat send, with the window (maxNumTokens) set to the positions LiteRT-LM allocates: fitContext counts what the cache will hold after the message's prefill (the conversation's token count plus the rendered message counted by the model's tokenizer, one more for BOS on an empty conversation, images and audio estimated) and, when that plus a reply reserve (min(maxNumTokens / 3, maxNumTokens / 4 + the thinking budget)) and a 64-token margin exceeds the window, rebuilds the conversation with the newest history that fits, throwing messageTooLong when the message doesn't fit even alone; runSend caps the reply with ContextBudget.outputCap = maxNumTokens - that count - 64 and throws contextFull when that is below 96 tokens; when any tool is offered (on-device tools or web_search) ToolBudget.plan gives each tool result an eighth of that room (in estimated tokens) and at most two calls, the first round min(room - two results - two later-round reserves, room / 2 + the thinking budget) and each later round half of what the first round and the results leave; and, with tools offered, a streaming guard cancels the conversation and throws replyTruncated when the estimated tokens emitted plus those of the tool results exceed the room.
note: Re-pin 2026-11-17, reconciliation r3, at Agello HEAD a69121286e; meaning changed since 93122b6. tokensAfterPrefill (160-170): getTokenCount + (1 if empty) + engine.countTokens(renderMessageIntoString) + media estimate. fitContext (475-523): fits = used + replyReserve + safetyMargin <= window (ContextBudget.fits, 144-148), replyReserve = min(w/3, w/4 + thinking) (140-142; was 512 + thinking), rebuild alone -> messageTooLong (492-494), then trimmed history. runSend (786-823): room = outputCap(maxNumTokens, used: prefilled, input: 0) = w - used - 64, nil below 96 -> contextFull (231-234, 63-65); ToolBudget.plan (ToolHost 69-88): results room/8, maxCalls 2, first = min(room - 2r - 2later, room/2 + thinking), followUp = (room - first - 2r)/2, no tools: min(room, maxOutputTokens). Guard (916-923) only with tools: estimateTextTokens(bytes, weight) + ToolBudget.resultTokens > room. maxNumTokens resolves through ContextBudget.allocatedPositions (97-102, 256-265).
